newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips end higher for first time this week.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips end higher for first time this week.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended higher Thursday for the first time this week as bargain-hunters bought battered shares, ignoring a sell-off in the bond market ahead of Friday's key November jobs report.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 14.16 points to 6,437.10. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a narrow margin on active volume of 485 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
